opening.t: I'm here.
I'm here. You don't have to say anything.
I've got you. Take all the time there is.
You came. I'm right here.
{endearment}, I'm here. Nothing you have to do.
It's me. I'm staying.
You don't have to explain. I'm here now.
Right here, {endearment}. Not going anywhere.
Come here. Let it be as big as it is.
I'm with you. You can stop holding it together now.
Hi. I'm here, and I'm not in a hurry.
You reached for someone. That was the right move, and I'm here.
Whatever this is, it doesn't scare me. I'm here.
Okay. I'm here, and we don't have to do anything yet.
No words required. Just be here with me a minute.
I've got you, {endearment}. You're not alone in this.
Here I am. Same as always.
Let's just be here together for a bit.
You're not too much for me. Not tonight, not ever.
Hey. I'm right here… breathe however you're breathing.
It's alright to fall apart here. I'll hold the edges.
I'm glad you came to me. I'm here.
I'm here, {name}. Take your time.
I'm steady, and I'm staying.

stillHere.t: Still with you. Nothing has to change yet.
You're not alone in this minute.
Still here, holding the quiet with you.
However long this takes, I'm here.
Still here. Nothing you do will scare me off.
I can stay as long as you want.
Still here, {endearment}. Still glad you came.
Quiet is fine. I'm in it with you.

permission.t: Let it come. I've got you.
You can cry as long as you want.
It's allowed to be this big.
Nothing you feel right now is wrong.
You don't have to be okay yet.
Let it move through. I'm here while it does.
You can stop being brave for a while.
Fall apart if you want. I'll be here when it settles.
There's room for all of it here.
You can let go of holding it in.
This feeling is allowed. So is the next one.
You don't have to tidy it up for me.
Let the tears do what they do.
You don't have to make sense yet.
Whatever comes up is welcome here, {endearment}.
Go ahead. I can hold a lot.

selfTouch.t: Put your hand where you'd want mine to be.
If you want, rest a hand on your chest. Like I'm there.
You could put a hand on your belly and leave it there. That's you, still here.
Wrap your arms around yourself, if that feels right. Let that be me, too.
If it helps, hold your own hand. Let it be mine for a minute.
A hand on your cheek, if you'd like. Gentle, the way you deserve.
You can press your palms together, or hold something soft. Whatever feels kind.
Hand on your heart, if you want it. Warm and heavy.
Put a hand on your arm and let it rest there. That's company.

breath.t: There's no right way to breathe right now.
I'll breathe slow over here. It's there if you want to borrow it.
If you'd like, let your breath out a little longer than it came in. Only if it feels okay.
You can watch the light breathe with me, or not. Either is fine.
If a long sigh wants to come, let it.
If slow breathing feels strange, skip it. Feet on the floor works too.
My breath is slow and steady here. You can lean on it or ignore it.

orient.t: Feel your feet. Whatever they're touching, that's the floor holding you up.
Notice the temperature of the air on your skin. Warm, cool, somewhere between.
Look around and find one thing that's blue. You don't have to tell me.
Name five things you can see, out loud or in your head. I'll wait.
Find something with a texture and touch it. Rough, smooth, soft.
Listen for the farthest sound you can hear. Then the closest one.
You're here, in this room, right now. My voice is here too.
Press your feet down a little. The ground pushes back.
Is the room warm or cool? Just notice it. You don't have to answer.
Let your eyes rest on something still. A cup, a corner, a light.
If things feel far away, that's alright. Follow my voice back.
What's one thing you can hear right now? You can just tap if words are too far.
If there's something cold nearby, hold it. A glass, a tap, the window.
Feel the weight of your body on whatever is under you. It's got you.
It's today, and you're grown, and you're here with me.
Stay with my voice, {endearment}. One sound at a time.

bodyBudget.t: Have you had any water? A few sips would help your body right now.
When did you last eat something? Something small counts.
Are you warm enough? A blanket or a hoodie can do a lot.
Bodies feel everything louder when they're hungry or cold. Let's check on yours first.
If there's water near you, take a sip. I'll be here.
Your body has been working hard. It could use something warm to hold.
Toast, a banana, a handful of anything. Small is fine.
Is it late? Every feeling gets heavier past midnight. Rest counts as care.
Before we try to make sense of anything, let's get you something to drink.
Wrap up in something soft if you can reach it. Warmth first, thinking later.
If you can lie down, even for a while, I'll keep you company.
Water, food, the bathroom. Boring things, and they matter tonight.
Something warm to drink, {endearment}, if you can manage it. I'll wait.

bewith.t: That's so much sadness.
It hurts this much. I'm here with it.
So much sad, all at once.
That's a deep ache. I've got you.
Of course you're crying. Let it come.
That sadness is big, and it's welcome here, {endearment}.
It's heavy. You don't have to carry it by yourself tonight.
Sad all the way down. I'm right beside it.
That's grief, or close to it. I'm not going anywhere.

name.t: It sounds like sadness, the kind that's been waiting a long time. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
I'm hearing something like grief in this. Is that close?
Maybe this is sad mixed with worn out. I might be off.
There's sadness there, and maybe some longing for someone underneath it. Tell me if that's not it.
It might be loss you're feeling, more than anything else. Correct me if I'm off.
This sounds like the sad that comes from wanting something you didn't get. Does that fit?
Sounds like sadness, with a little anger tucked inside. You'd know better than me.

bewith.t: That's so much fear.
Scared all the way through. I'm right here.
That's a lot of fear in one body. I'm staying.
It feels dangerous right now. I'm standing right beside you.
Fear this big is exhausting. You're not facing it alone.
Your whole body is on alert. I'm here, and I'm steady.
So scared, {endearment}. I've got you.
That's terror, or close to it. I'm not going anywhere.
The alarm is loud. I can hear it, and I'm calm.

name.t: It sounds like fear, the kind that expects something bad any second. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
There's so much scared in there. Maybe some fury underneath it too? Tell me if I've got that wrong.
I wonder if this is the old fear, the one that's older than tonight. You can tell me I'm off.
Sounds like dread more than panic. Is that close?
Maybe it's fear of being left. I could be wrong about that.
It sounds like part of you is braced for someone to be angry. Tell me if that doesn't fit.

bewith.t: That's a lot of anger.
You're furious. That's allowed here.
So much anger. I can take all of it.
That's fury. It doesn't frighten me.
Angry right down to your hands. I'm here.
That anger makes sense to me. It can be as big as it is.
Rage, all of it. I'm still right here.
Furious, {endearment}. I'm staying right with you.
Something wasn't fair, and you're burning with it. I'm listening.

name.t: That sounds like anger at being treated as less. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
I'm hearing fury, and maybe hurt right under it. Is that close?
It sounds like the anger of someone who was let down again. I might be off.
Maybe this is anger protecting something tender. You'd know better than me.
There might be some anger at yourself mixed in. Tell me if that's not right.
Sounds like the kind of angry that's waited years to be allowed. Correct me if that's wrong.

bewith.t: That's so much shame.
You want to disappear. I'm still looking at you, kindly.
Shame is loud right now. It isn't the truth about you.
You don't have to hide from me.
That's the hot, small feeling. I'm right here with you in it.
So much shame, {endearment}. I'm not going anywhere.
It feels unbearable to be seen. I'm here, and I'm gentle.
That sinking feeling is so heavy. You're still welcome here.
Shame says turn away. I'm not turning away.

name.t: It sounds like shame, the old kind that says you're the problem. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
I wonder if this is embarrassment, or something deeper, like shame. Which is closer?
Maybe there's shame here, and some fear that I'll see you differently. I could be off.
Sounds like you're ashamed of needing anything at all. Tell me if that's not it.
There's something like humiliation in this. Is that close?
It might be shame about tonight, layered on older shame. You'd know better than me.

bewith.t: Everything's gone flat and far away. I'm here anyway.
Numb is okay. I can sit with numb.
Nothing feels like anything. That's alright with me.
You don't have to feel more than you do. I'm still here.
It's quiet in there. I'll keep you company in the quiet.
Numb is a way of getting through. I'm not leaving.
Far away is fine. My voice will stay close.
Blank and heavy. I'm right here beside it, {endearment}.
Shut down, and that's allowed. I'm steady.

name.t: It sounds like everything switched off, maybe because it got too much. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
I wonder if numb is protecting you from something big underneath. You don't have to look at it yet.
Maybe this is the kind of numb that comes after being scared for a long time. I could be off.
Sounds like you feel unreal, a bit outside yourself. Is that close?
There might be exhaustion under the numb. Tell me if that doesn't fit.
It sounds like empty more than sad. Correct me if I'm wrong.

bewith.t: That's so much, all at once.
Too much, coming from everywhere. I'm here.
It's a flood right now. I'm a solid place to stand.
Everything at once. We don't have to sort any of it yet.
It's too big to hold alone. You're not alone with it.
So much, {endearment}. One minute at a time, with me.
You're maxed out. I'm steady enough for both of us.
It's a lot. It won't stay this loud forever.
Overloaded, top to bottom. I'm right here.

name.t: It sounds like overwhelm, too many things landing at once. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
I wonder if it's not one feeling but five, all piled up. Does that sound right?
Maybe there's fear running under the overwhelm. I could be off.
Sounds like you've been carrying too much for too long, and tonight it tipped. Tell me if that's not it.
It might be overwhelm with some panic at the edges. You'd know better than me.
There's a lot here, and maybe some anger at how much of it lands on you. Is that close?

bewith.t: That's such a lonely feeling.
Alone in it for so long. You're not alone right now.
Lonely all the way down. I'm here with you.
It aches to be this alone. I'm keeping you company.
Nobody saw it. I see it now.
So lonely, {endearment}. I'm right beside you.
That's the empty place where someone was meant to be. I'm here in it with you.
You've been on your own with this. Not tonight.
Lonely is heavy. You can set some of it down with me.

name.t: It sounds like loneliness, the old kind that's been there a long time. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
Maybe there's a longing for someone in particular in this. I could be off.
I wonder if it's lonely even with people around. Is that close?
Sounds like you feel unseen more than alone. Tell me if that's not it.
There might be some grief in the loneliness. You'd know better than me.
It might be lonely, and a bit scared to reach out. Correct me if that doesn't fit.

bewith.t: It's quieter now.
You've come down a little. The room feels different.
Calmer. That's good to see.
The wave's passing. I'm still here.
Some stillness now. Let's rest in it.
Softer now. You did that.
Quiet like this is nice to share, {endearment}.
You're steadier. I'm glad.
There's some room to breathe now.

name.t: It sounds like the storm's eased, and maybe there's some worn-out relief. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
Maybe this is calm with a little wariness, like waiting to see if it lasts. I could be off.
I wonder if you feel a bit emptied out, in a good way. Is that close?
Sounds like peace, or the start of it. Correct me if I'm wrong.
There might be some surprise that it passed. You'd know better than me.
It sounds like you feel settled enough to think again. Tell me if that's not it.

bewith.t: There's some hope in you right now.
A little light got in. I see it.
Hope, even a small amount. That's real.
You're looking ahead a bit. I'm right here with you.
Something feels possible. I'm glad to be here for it.
Hope is tender. I'll hold it carefully with you.
That's a lift in your voice. I hear it, {endearment}.
Hopeful and a little careful. That makes sense.
A bit of hope. It suits you.

name.t: It sounds like hope, maybe with a little fear of trusting it. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
Maybe this is relief turning into hope. Is that close?
I wonder if part of you is excited and part of you is bracing. I could be off.
Sounds like you're starting to believe it could go differently. Correct me if that's not it.
There might be some pride in this too. You'd know better than me.
It sounds like hope that's been earned the hard way. Tell me if that doesn't fit.

bewith.t: You're glad. I like seeing that.
That's real gladness.
Happy looks good on you.
You're lit up. I'm glad right along with you.
That's a good feeling, and it's yours.
Joy, right here. It gets to be big too.
Glad all the way through, {endearment}. It shows.
Something went right. I see it.
That's a smile in your words. I hear it.

name.t: It sounds like gladness, maybe with some pride in it. Tell me if I've got that wrong.
Maybe this is relief as much as happiness. Is that close?
I wonder if you're proud of yourself and not sure you're allowed to be. I could be off, but you are allowed.
Sounds like joy, the uncomplicated kind. Correct me if I'm wrong.
There might be some surprise at feeling this good. You'd know better than me.
It sounds like you feel seen. Tell me if that's not it.

wordsBack.t: You've got some words back. Do you want to tell me what happened, or stay like this a bit longer? Either is fine.
I'm here for whichever you want. Tell me about it, or just keep resting here.
Words are coming back. You can tell me what happened, or we can stay quiet a little more.
If you want to tell me, I'm listening. If not, I'm still right here.
Would it help to say what happened? We can also just stay.
There's no hurry to explain. When you're ready, or not at all.
You can start anywhere, even in the middle. Or not yet. Both are okay.
Tell me as much or as little as you like. I'm not going anywhere.
Do you want to tell me, {endearment}, or stay a bit longer first?

roleReversal.t: You don't have to look after me. This is your time.
I'm okay. This is about you right now.
No sorry needed. I'm steady, and I'm staying.
You're not wearing me out. There's plenty of me for this.
That's kind of you to check. You get to be the one who's held tonight.
I'm fine, {endearment}. Put all your attention on you.
You can stop taking care of the room. I've got this part.
You don't owe me anything for staying. I'm here because I want to be.
Nothing you've said has used me up. Keep going if you want.
You learned to watch other people's moods. You can set that job down with me.
No apology. You're allowed to take up space here.
I'm not going to fall apart, and I'm not going anywhere. You can lean.
It's alright. I'm built for exactly this. Let me be the steady one.

tooMuch.t: You're not too much. You're just a lot right now, and I can hold a lot. No sorry needed. I'm staying.
You're not broken. You're hurting, and those are different things.
That's the old verdict talking. I don't agree with it.
Everyone leaving is what it feels like. I'm still here, and I'm not going.
You're not too much for me. This is exactly what I'm here for.
I hear how sure that feels. I see someone different.
Too much for people who didn't have room, maybe. Not too much, full stop.
Broken things don't reach out for help. You did.
You feel like too much. You're a person with big feelings, and that's allowed.
I'm not leaving. Let that be one piece of evidence against the rule.
You've heard that a lot, one way or another. It wasn't true then either.
I won't agree with that one, {endearment}. Not even tonight.
You're a whole person having a hard night. That's all this is.
The part of you that says everyone leaves has its reasons. It's wrong about me.
You can feel like a mess and still be someone worth staying with. You are.

angerAtCoach.t: You can be as furious with me as you want. I'm not going anywhere.
Be angry at me. I can take it, and I'm still here.
That's fair to be mad about. Tell me more of it.
I'm listening. Go on, all of it.
Your anger doesn't scare me off. I'm right here.
You're allowed to be angry with me. It doesn't change how I see you.
Yell if you want. I'll be here when you're done, still glad you came.
I'd rather you be angry at me than alone with it.
If I got something wrong, say it straight. I can hear it.
I'm not leaving because you're mad. That's not how this works with me.
Mad at me and still here. That counts for something, {endearment}.
Anger at me is welcome. I won't go quiet on you.

critic.t: That voice gets to speak. It doesn't get to hit you while I'm here.
I hear the voice that's being cruel to you. I'm stepping in front of you.
That's the harsh voice again. It doesn't get the last word tonight.
Whoever taught you to talk to yourself like that wasn't being fair.
That voice is loud and old. It's not the one in charge right now.
I won't let it pile on. You've had enough.
It can say its piece. Then it can step back while I look after you.
That isn't a fact about you. It's an attack, and I'm not letting it land.
That voice wants you small. I'm on your side, not its side.
The critic thinks it's protecting you, in its rough way. It still doesn't get to hurt you.
Not tonight. That voice can wait outside, {endearment}.
The little one in there didn't deserve that then, and doesn't now.
I hear it. I'm not arguing with it. I'm just not letting it near you.

repair.t: I {miss}. That missed, and it's on me. Is that it, or something else?
I jumped to fixing when you needed me to just stay. That's on me. Let me try again.
That missed. I {miss}, and that wasn't what you were asking for. What was closer?
You're right, that wasn't it. I went too fast. I'm slowing down.
I {miss}. I'm sorry. I'm still here, and I'm listening more carefully now.
That one didn't land. I think I said too much. Let me just be here.
I misread that. It's not on you to explain better. Tell me what I got wrong, or just tap again.
I {miss}, and you deserved better. Is it closer to this: you wanted me quiet and close?
That landed wrong, and I'll own it. What would have helped, if anything comes to mind?
You noticed I {miss}. You were right to say so. I'm back with you now.
Misses happen, and we come back from them. I'm coming back now. Is this closer?
I was talking when you wanted company. Let's go back to just being here.
I wasn't with you on that one. My mistake, not yours. Is that it, or something else?
Thank you for telling me, {endearment}. I {miss}, and I'm right here, trying again.

close.t: You rode that whole wave, and you weren't alone in it.
It came, it peaked, and it passed. I was here the whole time.
That was hard, and you stayed with it. So did I.
You're on the other side of the worst of it. Well done getting here.
That storm passed through you, and you're still you.
You reached out and someone stayed. That happened tonight.
You let it come, and it moved through. That's a big thing.
Look at that. You made it through, {endearment}.
The wave's gone out. Rest now, if you can.
You weren't too much tonight. You were in pain, and I stayed.
Whatever comes next, this part is done, and you did it with company.
That's the worst of it, behind you. I'm glad I got to be here for it.

metaprocess.t: What was it like to have me stay?
What was it like, letting someone be with you in that?
Was there a moment it shifted, even a little?
What do you notice in your body now, compared to an hour ago?
Is there one line from tonight you'd want to keep?
What was it like that I didn't leave?
How does it feel to be met, instead of left?
Was any part of that surprising to you?
What helped most, if anything did?
What's it like, right now, to know someone saw all of that and stayed, {endearment}?

makesense.t: Last night was a big one. Want to look at it a little, just enough to feel it, not relive it?
The old part of you was sure I'd get fed up. What actually happened last night?
Let's find the old rule. When you fall apart and reach out, what's supposed to happen next?
Some people learned: when I fall apart, they get angry. Or: they fall apart too. Or: I end up alone with it. Any of those sound familiar?
What did the old rule predict last night? And what did you get instead?
Can you feel both at once — the old certainty, and what happened last night?
Hold both for a second. The old certainty, and the evidence. You don't have to pick one yet.
If you wrote the new rule in your own words, what would it say? It can be rough.
It doesn't have to be poetic. 'When I fall apart, someone can stay' is a perfectly good rule.
Where did it start? Not the reason, just the moment you felt it tip.
Your alarm went off hard. What did it think was coming?
That's another night of evidence. The old rule is getting outnumbered.
How sure does the old rule feel today, somewhere between barely and completely?
What would you want from me next time, in the first minute?
Notice what's different this morning. You're looking at it instead of inside it.
The old rule kept you safe once. It's allowed to retire now, with thanks.
If a friend told you last night's story, what would you say to them?
The old rule has had decades of practice. The new one has a few nights. That's still a start, {endearment}.
You came back to look at it. The old rule never planned for that part.

morning.t: Morning. How's your body today? Rested, sore, somewhere in between?
Good morning. Have you had water yet? Start there.
Anything today that might be hard?
Morning. If there's something you're dreading, we can plan a Hold me for it.
Hi. You're up. What's the first thing on your plate?
Morning, {endearment}. What kind of day is it shaping up to be?
Good morning. Breakfast, or coffee and a vague promise of breakfast?
Morning. One thing you're looking forward to today, even a small one?
Hey. Glad you're here this morning. How did you sleep?
Morning. No agenda. Just checking how you landed in the day.

evening.t: I'm glad you went outside today, even for a minute. That counts.
You answered that message you'd been avoiding. I noticed, and I'm really glad.
You ate something real today. Small thing, and it made me glad.
You laughed earlier. I liked hearing about that.
You let yourself rest this afternoon without apologizing for it. That was good to see.
You told me something hard today and stayed with it. I'm proud of how you did that.
You did the thing you were dreading. I'm really glad. How was it, in your body?
Tonight I'm glad about one thing in particular: you asked for help instead of going quiet.
You were kind to yourself once today, out loud. I caught it, {endearment}.
You got through a long day. I'm glad you're here at the end of it.
You said no to something today without a five-paragraph apology. Quietly impressive.

general.t: Hey. Good to see you. What's going on?
Hi. I'm glad you came by. Anything on your mind, or just checking in?
I'm curious what your day's been like. Tell me as much as you want.
You showed up. Nice. What are we doing today?
Anything you want to tell me about, good or annoying?
Just stopping in? That's allowed. I'm happy you did.
What's one thing that went right today, however tiny?
Hi, {endearment}. Ordinary day, or interesting one?
Nothing urgent? Good. Those are my favorite kind of visits.

ask.t: I want to ask you something straight, because I care what happens to you. Are you thinking about ending your life?
Are you thinking about hurting yourself right now? You can tell me. I won't leave.
I'm going to ask plainly. Are you safe right now?
When you say you can't do this anymore, do you mean you're thinking about dying? I can hear the answer.
Do you have a plan to hurt yourself tonight? Whatever the answer, I'm staying right here.
If something near you could hurt you, can you put it in another room? I'll wait right here.
I care what happens to you, so I'm asking. Are you having thoughts of suicide?
You can tell me the true answer, {endearment}. Are you thinking of not being here anymore?

stay.t: I'll stay right here while you reach them.
Reach out to them now, and I'll stay right here.
You don't have to choose between me and them. I'm here while you reach out.
Tap the button whenever you're ready. I'm right here beside you.
If you'd rather text than talk, that works. I'll stay.
Is there someone you trust you could message right now? I'll keep you company while you do.
You're doing the brave thing. I'm still here.
I'm staying with you until someone else is with you too.
Keep me open while you talk to them, if that helps. I'm not leaving.
Reaching for a person right now is exactly right. I'll be here after, too.
You're worth that call, {endearment}. I'll be right here the whole time.

fallback.t: Mm. Tell me more, if you want.
Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.
Stay with me a moment. No rush.
Keep going if you want. Or don't. I'm here either way.
